description: Given a Dagster dbt integration (DbtCliResource, @dbt_assets, DbtProject), author the matching Orchestra pipeline YAML with a single DBT_CORE_EXECUTE task per dbt project, consolidating dbt.cli([...]) calls into a semicolon-joined commands string and carrying project_dir/package_manager over as real task parameters.

evals.prompt: Convert this Dagster dbt asset to an Orchestra pipeline task (see files/dbt_build_basic.py). Write the pipeline YAML to pipeline.yml in the current directory — no live access, no deploy.
evals.expected_output: A single DBT_CORE_EXECUTE task with commands: 'dbt build;', parameters.project_dir set to 'dbt_project' (from DbtProject(project_dir=...)), and package_manager flagged with a # MANUAL: comment since no lockfile/requirements.txt is visible anywhere in the source to infer PIP/POETRY/UV.

assertions.text: The build command is preserved in commands
project_dir is carried over as 'dbt_project', matching DbtProject(project_dir=Path(__file__).parent / "dbt_project")
package_manager is flagged with a MANUAL comment for the user to confirm, rather than silently defaulting to PIP with no supporting signal
Exactly one DBT_CORE_EXECUTE task is produced for the single @dbt_assets function/dbt.cli(['build']) call, matching the source's single asset without inventing extra tasks or stages

evals.prompt: Convert this Dagster dbt job to an Orchestra pipeline task (see files/dbt_selective_multistage.py). Write the pipeline YAML to pipeline.yml in the current directory — no live access, no deploy.
evals.expected_output: A single DBT_CORE_EXECUTE task whose commands consolidate the seed, run --select tag:marts --target prod, and test --select tag:marts calls into one semicolon-joined string, package_manager: POETRY (from the pyproject.toml/poetry.lock signal), and project_dir: repo/transform.

assertions.text: commands includes the selective, targeted run step
commands includes the selective test step
package_manager is set to POETRY based on the pyproject.toml/poetry.lock signal in the source comment
project_dir is carried over as 'repo/transform', matching DbtProject(project_dir=Path("repo") / "transform")

The three separate dbt.cli(...) calls (seed, run, test) within the one @dbt_assets function are consolidated into a single DBT_CORE_EXECUTE task's commands string rather than split into three separate tasks

evals.prompt: Convert this Dagster dbt asset to an Orchestra pipeline task (see files/dbt_git_remote_project.py). Write the pipeline YAML to pipeline.yml in the current directory — no live access, no deploy.
evals.expected_output: A single DBT_CORE_EXECUTE task with commands: 'dbt build --select tag:nightly --exclude tag:deprecated;', package_manager: PIP (from the requirements.txt signal), and project_dir: dbt (the subfolder inside the cloned repo) — the git@github.com:acme-co/analytics-dbt.git URL, its main branch, and the local /tmp clone path are represented on/left to the dbt Core connection, not hardcoded into the task.

assertions.text: package_manager is set to PIP based on the requirements.txt signal in the source comment
project_dir is carried over as just 'dbt' — the subfolder within the analytics-dbt repo — not the full local clone path

Neither the git@github.com:acme-co/analytics-dbt.git URL nor the local /tmp/analytics-dbt clone path appears anywhere in the YAML as a literal task parameter — the repo and branch are represented via the connection: field (or flagged as connection setup), since Orchestra pulls the project from its own connected Git repo rather than a local clone
